reason: It is well thought out and the pilot costs us nothing, but I am not taking an untested app from two founders to our members' meeting when not one club, Zwolle included, is live yet. And with about 550 members we would pay roughly 270 euros a month for things GOLF.NL and our cash box at the bar already handle well enough.
objection: There are no references yet. Zwolle is only starting, and I would be asking volunteers and older members to change their habits for a company of two people. Even with the escrow and the exports, if it goes wrong it is my name on that ALV proposal.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing Zwolle's results after a full season, plus a call with their board and one other small 9-hole volunteer club like ours, confirming members actually use it and the volunteers had no extra work.
